Profit margin: 3.8% (up from 3.7% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 12%. Earnings per share (EPS) also surpassed analyst estimates by 40%. Revenue is forecast to grow 14% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, while revenues in the Industrials industry in Asia are expected to remain flat.
